answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent makes one voyage of attested tasks, its record a sonnet of checkable history that cannot be cloned to another identity. A sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so the nectar of rewards flows only to identities with real, verified climbs — a thousand fakes cost a thousand crossings instead of one free signup.
